jobs.title: Software Engineer, GenAI Platform
jobs.description:
Roblox is a platform enabling users and creators to build and participate in immersive 3D digital experiences. The Software Engineer, GenAI Platform will build and operate platforms and services for machine learning, generative AI, and agentic experiences, while improving the speed, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency of AI development at scale.

Responsibilities

Build platforms and services that power machine learning, generative AI and agentic platform and product experiences across Roblox
Explore emerging technologies, including ML frameworks, LLMs, agentic systems, distributed systems, and GPU infrastructure
Improve the speed, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency of AI development
Contribute to systems operating at Roblox scale while balancing quality, latency, reliability, and responsible data use

jobs.title: ML Technical Lead, Agentic Interactions
jobs.description:
Sandbar is seeking a technical lead for its Stream consumer product. The role sets technical direction and leads development of self-aligned agentic experiences, including conversational interactions and information retrieval, while building and optimizing model development and inference systems.

Responsibilities

Lead architecture, strategy, and tradeoffs for our ML-based products

Optimize inference pipelines for latency, reliability, and concurrency
Work closely with other ML/AI engineers, infrastructure engineers, designers, and cofounders on existing and future products

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Applied AI
jobs.description:
About Wonderschool

Wonderschool’s mission is to ensure every child has access to early childhood education that helps them realize their full potential. We empower small business owners, childcare providers, to launch and grow in-home programs through cutting-edge software, personalized coaching, and responsive support. We also partner with governments to modernize public childcare infrastructure. Our team is small, fast-moving, and deeply motivated by the impact we create in families and communities across the country.

About The Role

We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to lead product development on some of the most strategically important initiatives at Wonderschool. You’ll spend your time working directly with customers (traveling as needed), uncovering pain points, and building AI-powered solutions that drive measurable impact across revenue, operational efficiency, and user experience. You’ll act like a founder inside the company: identifying problems, shipping code, driving adoption, and iterating quickly based on what you learn. This role blends engineering, product, operations, and business leadership, and is ideal for someone who has launched products, acquired users, and driven growth independently. You will work closely with our sales, onboarding, and account management teams to automate workflows, build better customer experiences, and unlock new growth.

This role is inspired by best-in-class FDSEs at companies like Palantir and is perfect for builders who love solving real-world problems in the field, not from behind a desk.

What You’ll Do

Work directly with users and internal teams to identify high-leverage problems and ship product solutions. Write production code (approximately 50% of your time) and ship weekly improvements across the customer journey. Use tools like Widesurf, Cursor, and other AI accelerators to increase your velocity and quality of output. Build and deploy AI-powered tooling that eliminates manual effort and improves the experience for providers, parents, and government partners. Automate onboarding flows, proposal generation, reporting processes, and other operational workflows. Own full loops: talk to users, design solutions, write code, test, deploy, and monitor adoption. Prioritize based on business impact and collaborate across teams to drive measurable results.

What Success Looks Like

You uncover user pain points faster than anyone else and consistently ship solutions that address them. You deploy AI-infused internal tools or product experiences that improve core metrics (conversion, retention, revenue). You fully own feedback loops, from discovery to deployment, and iterate rapidly. Internal teams rely on your tools to operate faster and with fewer resources. You’re moving fast, staying close to the customer, and operating with very little hand-holding.

Who You Are

A builder and founder at heart, you’ve started a company, built products that got users, or made revenue independently. Comfortable talking to users weekly and distilling insight into product decisions. Technical enough to ship production code on your own, experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar languages. Experienced using AI/LLMs and developer tools like Windsurf and Cursor to move faster and smarter. Business-minded, you’ve worked in consulting, managed a P&L, or attended business school and know how to prioritize based on ROI. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and energized by a high-trust, high-impact, in-person environment.

Why Join Us

Make a direct impact on families, small business owners, and communities. Operate with founder-like ownership on the company’s most important priorities. Join a small, fast-moving team with a bias for action. Talk to users, ship weekly, and see your work go live and drive real-world outcomes. Help reimagine early education and child care for the modern era.

Location

In-person, 5-6 days a week. This role requires regular client travel.

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Education Management

jobs.title: Applied Scientist - Remote
jobs.description:
Applied Scientist

Role Type:
Contractor

Location:
Remote

Job Description

We are seeking experienced Applied Scientists to support an AI training project focused on statistical analysis, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative problem-solving. Prior AI experience is not required.

Required Skills

Python, Pandas, and Scikit-learn
Applied Statistics and Experimental Design
Machine Learning and Data Modeling
Data Analysis and Transformation
Quantitative Reasoning
Technical Documentation
Analytical Thinking and Communication

Responsibilities

Analyze complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
Develop, test, and evaluate machine learning models.
Design experiments and interpret results.
Evaluate AI outputs for statistical accuracy and reasoning.
Create expert-level prompts, datasets, and reference solutions.
Identify methodological errors and provide structured feedback.
Deliver reproducible code and clear analytical reports.

Qualifications

At least one year of experience at a leading technology, finance, or research organization.
Strong Python and machine learning expertise.
Experience in statistics, experimentation, and data science.
Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
Advanced academic background or practical experience in data science, applied mathematics, or a related field.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Contract

Industries

Artificial Intelligence

jobs.title: Microbiome & Translational Research Scientist - Remote
jobs.description:
Clinical, Microbiome & Translational Research Scientist (PhD)

Job Type:
Contractor

Location:
Remote – Worldwide

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced research scientists to support an AI training project focused on microbiome science, clinical bioinformatics, and translational research. Contributors will develop scientific problems, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and provide expert feedback.

Required Skills

Microbiology and Bioinformatics
Microbiome and Metagenomics Analysis
Clinical and Translational Research
Python and R Programming
Statistical Analysis and Machine Learning
Biomarker Discovery and Clinical Genomics
Scientific Writing and Literature Review
Analytical Reasoning and Documentation

Responsibilities

Develop challenging scientific problems with verifiable solutions.
Evaluate AI outputs for scientific accuracy and reasoning.
Create reference answers and assessment rubrics.
Analyze microbiome, genomic, and clinical datasets.
Document findings and participate in peer reviews.

Qualifications

PhD in Microbiology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Immunology, Epidemiology, or a related field.
Hands-on academic or industry research experience.
Professional written and spoken English proficiency (C1 or higher).

Preferred Qualifications

Postdoctoral or industry research experience.
Experience with QIIME2, Kraken2, MetaPhlAn, HUMAnN, or clinical genomics tools.
Publications in relevant scientific journals.
Knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, and high-dimensional biological data analysis.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Contract

Industries

Artificial Intelligence

jobs.title: Life Sciences Research Scientist - Remote
jobs.description:
Life Sciences Research Scientist (PhD): Wet Lab & Computational Biology

Job Type:
Contractor

Location:
Remote – Worldwide

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced life sciences researchers to support an AI training project by developing scientific problems, evaluating AI-generated outputs, and validating experimental and computational reasoning.

Required Skills

Molecular Biology, Genetics, and Biochemistry
Genomics, Transcriptomics, and Single-Cell Analysis
Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
Proteomics, Metabolomics, and Epigenomics
Wet Lab Research and Experimental Design
Scientific Data Analysis and Interpretation
Research Documentation and Critical Thinking

Responsibilities

Develop challenging scientific problems and reference solutions.
Evaluate AI outputs for scientific accuracy and rigor.
Create assessment rubrics based on established research methods.
Validate experimental designs and computational workflows.
Provide clear scientific explanations and participate in peer reviews.

Qualifications

Completed PhD in a life sciences field or a closely related discipline.
Hands-on research experience in an academic or industry laboratory.
Professional written and spoken English proficiency (C1 or higher).

Preferred Qualifications

Practical wet lab experience, including PCR, cell culture, sequencing, or protein analysis.
Postdoctoral or advanced academic research experience.
Peer-reviewed scientific publications.
PhD from a leading research university.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Contract

Industries

Artificial Intelligence
